notice.title: 1753 Public Notice: Rescheduling of National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination (NCHM JEE) -2020 from 25.04.2020 (Saturday) to 22.06.2020 (Monday) from 3.00 PM to 6.00 PM. Read More

exam_date.evidence: The National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination (NCHM JEE)- 2020 which was to be conducted on 25.04.2020 (Saturday) had to be postponed due to the extraordinary circumstances arising from COVID-19 pandemic
